title.narrative: Support to GoI in Designing a Nesting Framework for High Quality and High Integrity Jusridictional REDD+ Implementation

description.narrative:
This project, implemented by Yayasan Konservasi Cakrawala Indonesia, supports the Government of Indonesia to improve carbon governance and optimize forest carbon revenues by incorporating nesting wwithin both jurisdictional and project approaches.
Outcomes: 1. Development of nesting scenarios to enable the co-existence between projects and jurisdictional REDD+ to ensure the optimum benefit of Indonesia 2. Alignment of technical elements among various standards and national processes to enable implementation of high quality and high integrity projects and program at various level of jurisdictions. 3. Development of key enabling policy for the implementation of the jurisdictional REDD+ program and its nesting process. 4. Capacity building, communication, and consultation for the implementation of the jurisdictional REDD+ program and its nesting process.
Target group: Direct beneficiaries: Ministry of Forestry, Ministry of Environment, private sector/carbon project developers. Indirect beneficiaries: Select provincial governments (as per Ministry of Forestry), indigineous people and local communities.
